name: real-estate-landing-page
description: A professional landing page for a real estate business to establish online presence and provide essential contact information

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:html
scripts.build:html: npx html-minifier --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css true --minify-js true -o dist/index.html index.html
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx serve dist
